key_insight: FARMS turns computational mathematics into reusable, AI-ready knowledge that links formal statements with source context, algorithms and quantitative guarantees.
engineering_relevance: It provides a foundation for AI systems to select and reuse numerical methods with explicit mathematical guarantees.
method: Prepare sources and encode mathematical knowledge in reusable representations.
Apply semantic review to connect formal statements with computational meaning.
Use Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises to connect selected statements to computational skills.
evidence_signal: The pipeline accepted 157 of 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical PDEs, with estimated mean costs of US $0.85–2.29 per target across sources; demonstrations included a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression.
watch_item: Lean-checked guarantees depend on explicit source premises and cover selected statements, not the correctness of an entire automated scientific workflow.
paper_title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
